{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column to check for thousands separators
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", sales['revenue'].astype(str).unique()[:10])

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].astype(str).str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Number of rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion worked
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:", sales['revenue_clean'].head())"}
